nvitk.restoration.mri_super_resolution.MRI_SR_FEATURES: tuple[str, Ellipsis] = ('vgg', 'grader')¶
nvitk.restoration.mri_super_resolution.mri_super_resolution(image: nvitk.types.Image | numpy.ndarray, *, expansion_factor: Sequence[float | int] | list[float] | tuple[float, Ellipsis] = (1, 1, 2), feature: str = 'vgg', verbose: bool = False) → numpy.ndarray¶

ANTsPyNet deep back-projection MRI super-resolution.

Parameters:

  • image – Input MRI volume.

  • expansion_factor – Per-axis integer upsampling factors. Supported: 1,1,2, 1,1,3, 1,1,4, 1,1,6, 2,2,2, 2,2,4. Must be ints (floats like 1.0 are coerced only when exactly integral).

  • feature – Feature backbone: vgg or grader (1,1,6 + grader has no weights).
